reviews.t: I'm a hairdresser by trade and I am happily impressed by this dryer
reviews.x: I'm a hairdresser by trade and I am happily impressed by this dryer. The heat, power and weight of this dryer are spot on. The color and price were my selling point. (which to be honest I hugely doubted) The only 2 complaints I have with this dryer are the placement of the cool button and the cord is a little too short to get to the other side of my chair. (easy fix with an extension cord) All in all... Very happy with my purchase!

I won't lie, the reviews made me a little hesitant to buy this hair dryer. Almost all the reviews are good, but a lot of them were in exchange for this hair dryer. I'm so glad I bought it though. This thing is amazing. It has way more power than my last hair dryer, and it's quieter. If my daughter says something to me while I'm using it, I can actually hear her.  It's feels solid, but is not that heavy. I can blow dry my hair in a just a few minutes now; it took f o r e v e r before. The pink is

reviews.t: Began to fail on first use
reviews.x: I bought this hair dryer because of the review Sweethome gave it. I did check the Fakespot scores for the quality of Amazon reviews on this product and it gave it an F, but for some reason I decided to trust Sweethome more. On the first use the Peony started to intermittently make harsh grinding noises. During a "grinding attack", the heat from the Peony would decrease, the air speed would decrease (make sense if the motor or fan is grinding), but more alarmingly little white specks woul

I wanted to love it and I did when it worked.  Pretty pink, durable long cord and light weight.  After only one month this one died on me.  I plugged it in, it got really hot and smelled horrible.  My husband said it was the circuit board that fried.  Too bad, maybe just a lemon.  Amazon is taking it back.

reviews.t: Cute pink hair dryer with a long cord!
reviews.x: This hair dryer is super cute, the color is a rich hot fink with black trim. I received it to review and all opinions expressed are my honest opinion. I already had a decent hair dryer, but was interested in getting a second non-travel sized dryer. I think this may replace my existing hairdryer.  What I like: *It has the options I use: two speeds, three temperature ranges, cool air shot, etc. *The attractive appearance is a plus as I am planning to use it in my swimming/gym bag. Yes it is bigger

Hair dryer worked fine for 45 days. It has a 2-year warranty now will not work on High Heat/Turbo. Works on low setting only for a few minutes before making a horrible screeching noise and smelling like burning plastic.  Contacted company to get a replacement or repair.  No reply. NOT Salon Quality, as only used once per day. Salons would use multiply times per day and expect it to at least live through its warranty period.

Upon opening the box, I assumed I was getting a steal of a deal with how fancy the box looked.  Then, there was a box within that box that looked just as nice.  I was very impressed by the packaging.  The box included the hair dyer, two different end caps, and a piece of paper with description, instructions, warranty info, etc.  The instructions didn’t really give much useful information.  Nowhere on the piece of paper did it mention why you would choose to use one head attachment over the other

reviews.t: great for a few months and then a really bad ...
reviews.x: Paid too much for this to have it fail within six months.  It got really hot as described in other reviews, and then started making the screeching noise also described in other reviews.  It wasn't hair getting stuck inside, either.  So, great for a few months and then a really bad purchase.  I'm reading that the company is not responsive to customer issues, which isn't good.  I guess any company with something to sell can do so on Amazon.

reviews.t: ... little bit heavy & the controls are in THE WORST spot ever
reviews.x: A little bit heavy & the controls are in THE WORST spot ever.  Hairdryer shuts down every 30 seconds b/c of bad location for controls.  Have found an awkward way to hold the hairdryer to keep it going.  Power of air is GREAT.  Would have given 5 stars except for heavy device and bad placement for controls.  Not sure if humans w hands were considered in the actual design....  Otherwise solid & good.

This hairdryer malfunctioned almost immediately upon use.  It wouldn't blow on high heat after about the third use, but it still worked okay on the low setting.  Now, six months later, it is smoking and cannot be used.  Waste of money.  Never again.  But- it is a pretty pink.  That's about the only positive.

reviews.t: Useless and disappointed. In the trash.
reviews.x: Worst. Dryer. Ever. Awkward handle that always resulted in me changing the speeds or temperature due to the button placement and ease of pressing. Would never just STAY hot, would constantly fluctuate between hot and cold, staying mostly on the colder side. Threw it away and invested in a proper hair dryer.
I've barely used this dryer maybe 2 dozen times and already the motor is already going out! Super disappointed

First of all the packaging for this hair dryer was amazing. It was securely in the box with the two attachments. Secondly, the color is SO pretty, I love it. My hair is very long (and thick) but I was able to dry it within twenty minutes - which is unheard of. It's light weight, compact and less noisy than my previous hairdryer. Also, the cord is long, which is important as I style my hair at my vanity and the outlet is close to the floor. I haven't had any issues with it overheating as mentione

It's a great Pink color but then as I did my research I thought this one was the best of the Pink ones I could find.  There are great features such as the long cord. reviews.t: POWERFUL blow dryer can handle my thick hair.
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:4ae69772771ce11535f9b2599e9029b0]] Finally a blow dryer that can take on my thick, straight hair. I have had a lesser model for quite a few years and feel like this product is a HUGE upgrade. It really packs the punch for the size at 1875 watts. The cord is extra long so I can always walk around my vanity area and still crane my neck if I needed to check on the kids. There are two speed settings and two temp plus a cool shot button. My toddlers love that blow drying their hair is takin

But as soon as I turned it on for the first time, it emitted a loud noise that I can only describe as being between a screech and a whistle. I thought perhaps there was a fastener I needed to undo, but no - the dryer was simply malfunctioning. While it is easily disassembled, I would discourage anyone from doing so as it isn't necessary to fix the problem. I was already sold the minute I saw it came with 2 skinny diffusers, and after reading reviews, I liked more of what I saw. I'd never heard of or tried Xtava brand before, so I figured I'd give it a go since the conventional blow dryers I find in stores always seem to break down after about a year or two of use. reviews.t: Love the color!.  Great hair dryer!
reviews.x: [[ASIN:B00RPJZMUM xtava Peony 1875W Hair Dryer with Turbo JOHNSON Motor - Ultra Powerful Professional Performance with Compact and Colorful Design (Pink)]]  This is a great compact hair dryer. Silly yes, to be as excited with the color, but it is nice to have tools that are functional and aesthetically pleasing.  It has 2 speeds and 2 heat options.  It also has a cold shot button

reviews.t: Was awesome but blower stopped working within 2 months
reviews.x: I actually loved this hairdryer! But to my dismay, 2 months after I bought it (just a couple of days ago) the blower stopped working. It will heat up but will not blow any air. I used it once every other day for approximately 5 minutes, because it dried my hair super fast, on medium heat, high air. My husband used it on his beard a couple of times a week or so. This should not have happened.  I contacted Xtava since the unit is under warranty but they are undergoing a brand relaunch and have no

Dryer is lightweight, operates well,  and dries hair safely and quickly, BUT...... the heat and speed tabs are located so that no matter how I hold the dryer, I keep accidentally changing the speed or heat, or I turn off the dryer altogether while I'm using it. I'm really disappointed. I'm going to have to return a dryer which is absolutely excellent if only I could keep it running!

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the dryer's strong airflow and power, saying it outperforms their previous drugstore dryers.
A common complaint is that the dryer breaks down or malfunctions after a short time, sometimes within weeks or months, with issues like overheating, burning smells, and screeching noises.
Several reviewers find the controls poorly placed, causing accidental changes to settings or the dryer shutting off during use.
Some reviewers note the dryer is quieter and lighter than expected, though a few find it a bit heavy.
Reviewers frequently mention the attractive pink color and nice packaging as positives.

qa.q: Is it lightweight enough for travel?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on weight: one calls it light weight and compact [2], while others describe it as a bit heavy for its size or just heavy [3][5]. No review directly addresses travel use.

claims.text: It is light weight and compact.
Its weight seems a bit heavy for its size.
It is a little bit heavy.

qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

Reviews disagree on loudness: some say it's quieter than their previous dryers [2][3][4], while others report a loud screeching/whistling noise, either from a malfunction [1] or after months of use [5].

claims.text: It is quieter than previous hair dryers and you can hear someone speaking while using it.
One reviewer reported a loud noise between a screech and a whistle from a malfunctioning unit.
Another reviewer reported it started making a screeching noise after a few months.

qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.
Reviews disagree: several call the cord long [1][2][3][5][6], but one hairdresser says it's a little too short to reach the other side of their chair [4].

One reviewer says the cord is a little too short to reach the other side of their chair.
